example_summary: M's share swap in an amalgamation resulted in a ₹ 50,000 market value gain, which the AO wants to tax as an exchange.
source_provision:
### Master Statutory Summary Matrix

| Section / Provision | Legal Trigger & Qualifying Conditions | Statutory Treatment & Tax Impact |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Section 47(vii)** | Shareholder transfers shares in Amalgamating Company in exchange for allotment of shares in Amalgamated Company (Must be an **Indian Company**). | **Not regarded as a Transfer**. Zero Capital Gains tax liability at the time of amalgamation. |
| **Section 49(2)** | Determination of Cost of Acquisition of newly allotted shares in the Amalgamated Company. | Cost = **Cost of acquisition of original shares** in the amalgamating company. |
| **Section 2(42A)(c)** | Determination of Period of Holding for newly allotted shares in the Amalgamated Company. | Period includes **period of holding of original shares** held in the amalgamating company. |


**Statutory Checklist for Section 47(vii) Exemption:**

* **Scheme of Amalgamation:** The transfer of original shares must be executed strictly pursuant to a court-approved scheme of amalgamation.

* **Consideration Condition:** The consideration for transfer must consist **solely of the allotment of shares** in the amalgamated company.

* **Residency Requirement:** The amalgamated company **must be an Indian company** for the exemption to apply.


> [!IMPORTANT]
> Irrelevance of Market Value Appreciation: Any higher market valuation or nominal increment in the value of shares allotted by the amalgamated company does NOT constitute a taxable exchange. Because Section 47(vii) explicitly states it is not a transfer, no Capital Gains can be levied u/s 45.

director.justification: The case tests whether M's share swap during amalgamation meets Section 47(vii) statutory criteria to override the Assessing Officer's proposal to tax the ₹ 50,000 market value appreciation.
director.visual_metaphor: A statutory compliance gatekeeper verifying amalgamation credentials to block an illegal tax assessment shield.

beat_plan.beat_goal: Establish M's share swap transaction and the Assessing Officer's tax demand on excess market value.
Introduce Section 47(vii) core mandate excluding share exchanges in amalgamation from being treated as transfer.
Verify statutory conditions required under Section 47(vii) for tax exemption.
Address the irrelevance of ₹ 50,000 market value increase and reject the AO proposal.
Detail Section 49(2) rule for cost of acquisition of newly allotted shares.
Explain Section 2(42A)(c) rule for computing period of holding.
Summarize the final legal takeaway confirming zero tax liability and rejection of AO proposal.

beats.voice_sync_text: Amalgamation സമയത്ത് shares exchange ചെയ്യുമ്പോൾ Capital Gains tax ബാധകമാണോ എന്ന് Section 47(vii), Section 49(2), Section 2(42A) എന്നിവ ഉപയോഗിച്ച് നമുക്ക് പഠിക്കാം. M എന്ന വ്യക്തിക്ക് ABC Ltd-ൽ 2000 shares ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു. 31.3.2026-ൽ നടന്ന amalgamation വഴി M-ന് പുതിയ കമ്പനിയിൽ 1000 shares ലഭിച്ചു. ഇതിന്റെ market value പഴയതിനേക്കാൾ ₹ 50,000 excess value ഉള്ളതുകൊണ്ട് Assessing Officer ഇത് tax ചെയ്യാൻ ശ്രമിക്കുന്നു.
beats.director_goal: Establish M's share swap transaction and the Assessing Officer's tax demand on excess market value.

beats.voice_sync_text: Section 47(vii) പ്രകാരം, ഒരു amalgamating company-യിലെ shares തന്ന് Amalgamated Company-യിലെ shares വാങ്ങുന്നത്, Income Tax Act-ന്റെ దృష్టిയിൽ Not regarded as a Transfer ആണ്.

visual_data.rule: Any transfer by a shareholder in a scheme of amalgamation of a capital asset being a share or shares held by him in the amalgamating company.

beats.director_goal: Introduce Section 47(vii) core mandate excluding share exchanges in amalgamation from being treated as transfer.

beats.voice_sync_text: ഇതിന് ചില നിബന്ധനകളുണ്ട്. Amalgamated company ഒരു Indian Company ആയിരിക്കണം. പ്രതിഫലം Solely Share Consideration ആയിരിക്കണം, കൂടാതെ ഇത് ഒരു Scheme of Amalgamation പ്രകാരം ആയിരിക്കണം.
beats.director_goal: Verify statutory conditions required under Section 47(vii) for tax exemption.

beats.voice_sync_text: പുതിയ shares-ന്റെ ₹ 50,000 Market Value കൂടുതൽ ആണെങ്കിൽ പോലും, Section 45 പ്രകാരം ഇതിനെ ഒരു transfer ആയി കാണാൻ കഴിയില്ല. അതുകൊണ്ട് AO Proposal Not Justified.

visual_data.rule: Section 45 does not trigger as Section 47(vii) overrides it. AO Proposal Not Justified.

beats.director_goal: Address the irrelevance of ₹ 50,000 market value increase and reject the AO proposal.

beats.voice_sync_text: Section 49(2) അനുസരിച്ച്, amalgamated company-യിൽ ലഭിച്ച പുതിയ shares-ന്റെ Cost of Acquisition എന്നത് പഴയ Original Shares Cost തന്നെയായിരിക്കും.
beats.director_goal: Detail Section 49(2) rule for cost of acquisition of newly allotted shares.

beats.voice_sync_text: Section 2(42A)(c) പ്രകാരം, പുതിയ shares short-term ആണോ long-term ആണോ എന്ന് നിർണ്ണയിക്കുമ്പോൾ, പഴയ company-യിൽ ആ shares എത്രകാലം കയ്യിൽ വെച്ചു എന്ന Period of Holding കൂടി കൂട്ടി ചേർക്കണം. 31.3.2026 വരെയുള്ള കാലയളവ് ഇതിൽ ഉൾപ്പെടും.
beats.director_goal: Explain Section 2(42A)(c) rule for computing period of holding.

beats.voice_sync_text: ചുരുക്കത്തിൽ, Section 47(vii) Exemption ഉള്ളതിനാൽ ഇവിടെ Zero Capital Gains ആണ് വരുന്നത്. Assessing Officer-ന്റെ AO Proposal Rejected.
beats.director_goal: Summarize the final legal takeaway confirming zero tax liability and rejection of AO proposal.
